faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad (MNNIT Allahabad) for a project-based position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by MNNIT Allahabad?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow (On Contract) under a DST sponsored project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (On Contract) post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form along with required documents is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech. or B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering or allied relevant branches along with a valid GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or stipend offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs. 37,000.00 per month plus 20% HRA as per project norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for MNNIT Allahabad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to send hard copies via post and soft copies via email before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the offline application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Office of the Dean (Research & Consultancy), MNNIT Allahabad, Prayagraj - 211004, superscribing the envelope accordingly.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for submitting the application form.
